identity.title: [v0.92.1][AWS][runtime-v3] Cut warm Polis GPU startup with prebuilt artifacts and persistent EBS

values.summary: The warm two-node AWS Polis reached service readiness in 235 seconds and executed two models plus six ACC agents, but exact-head review rejected two recovery assertions because their source lifecycle phases were not retained in the qualification receipt. The source-proof repair is implemented and locally validated; one corrected live proof remains pending.
actual_changes: Added a dedicated recovery-proof helper that binds the exact Guardian lifecycle report digest and validates dependency-degradation, Vector-liveness, and log-stagnation injection/recovery records.
Packaged the current qualifier and recovery helper directly into warm Runtime user data so no AMI, warm volume, package installation, Git operation, model download, or compilation is required.
Added deterministic negative tests for missing phases, reversed recovery timestamps, evaluation violations, and report-hash mismatch.
Corrected design and runbook truth for Guardian-before-GPU readiness and the exact preparation cleanup/resume boundary.
Marked the first current-quota qualification evidence rejected by review instead of retaining unsupported claims.
Reconciled the completed run's AWS instance lifetimes and zero-residue proof into a USD 19.737366 historical upper bound, leaving one USD 0.242333 proof-recovery reservation under the USD 20 ceiling.

actual_validation.purpose: Validate the issue-specific preparation and acceptance contract.
Prove the Terraform, proof-binding, negative-test, cost, cleanup, and warm-launch contracts without AWS mutation.
Retain the corrected source-bound live recovery proof under current quota.
